system.description:
This... is my BOOMSTICK! —Ash, Army of Darkness Attitude and tenacity are as core to the gunslinger as ammo. They stare down challenges through iron sights, fortified by their inner grit.

The gunslinger is a low-defense, highcrit striker. In combat, stay as far back as possible and keep the enemy under constant fire.

  • Action: Attack
  • Move: Backline
  • Key Stat: Awareness
  • Complexity: HHHII
  • Training: Detect, Ranged

Trainings at Level 1: the Class's Trainings, plus a number of additional Trainings equal to half your Reason (round up).

features.name: Deadeye
features.description: After you make a Ranged attack, you Crit on subsequent Ranged attacks on a d20 roll 1 lower, and can stack up to 3 times. It resets at the end of your Turn if you didn't hit a Ranged attack since the start of your last Turn.

features.name: Shooting Irons
features.description: You gain the Quick Draw Perk (p. 71) and, once per Round, you can make a Ranged attack against an attack that would hit. If you pass, reduce the damage dealt by the Target's attack by your attack's damage.

features.name: Bad Medicine
features.description:
You deal an extra die of damage when you Crit with a Ranged Check. The number of extra dice increases by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

Gunslinger: 2nd, 6th, 10th Level.

features.name: Grit
features.description:
At the start of your Turn, you can remove 3 Deadeye stacks to remove a Status from yourself from either Blinded, Burning, Confused, Dazed, or Frightened.

The Deadeye stacks removed by this Ability are reduced by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter (minimum 0).

Gunslinger: 4th, 8th Level.

features.name: Devastator
features.description: When you Crit with a Ranged Check, the damage dice can Explode.

features.name: High Noon
features.description: When you kill an Enemy, your Deadeye is immediately set to 17.
